note: Board and go (brief 018 §5), the twin of route-g-fast: the same route to the ambush; then the Enforcer walks Vale to the car as it springs, the three fire until the blocker is down, then board, and the car leaves with the whole cell. Route G, fast (brief 013 D; Motive 013 §6.1 G-fast): route G with the patrol rerouted as soon as the loop holds and the guard knocked out the moment the patrol leaves (2:01). Half a minute earlier, but his 2:30 mark is missed while the Enforcer is still inside: the gamble Motive names (robots on the forecourt as he comes out), which the dial's 60 m robot reach and the patrol's reroute answer on this block.
